description: Migrate all 7 service files and the dashboard/reminders route from Mongoose to the Supabase db layer (Steps E, F, G). Also migrate the seed. Depends on FEAT-002 (db layer must exist). Services migrated: auth.service.js, auth.routes.js, treatment-category.service.js, patient.service.js, appointment.service.js, payment.service.js, clinical.service.js, ai.service.js, routes/index.js (dashboard + reminders), src/config/seed.js.
steps: Migrate Backend/src/services/auth.service.js: Replace `require('../models/user.model')` with `const { userDb } = require('../db')`. In login(): replace User.findOne().select('+passwordHash') with userDb.findByEmail(normalizedEmail); replace user._id.toString() with user.id; replace User.findByIdAndUpdate with userDb.updateLastLogin(user.id). Remove all mongoose references.

Migrate Backend/src/routes/auth.routes.js: Replace all inline model requires (User, Clinic, bcrypt lazy requires inside handlers) with top-level imports. Replace User.find({role:'doctor',status:'active'}) with userDb.findDoctors({status:'active'}). Remove the inline doctor-creation fallback (if doctors.length === 0). Replace User.find({}) in GET /staff with userDb.findAllStaff(). Replace User.findOne/User.create/User.findById/user.save() in POST /staff and PUT /staff/:id with userDb.findByEmail, userDb.createUser, userDb.findById, userDb.updateUser. Replace _id.toString() with .id everywhere. Map clinic creation to clinicDb.getDefaultClinic().

Migrate Backend/src/services/treatment-category.service.js: Replace model imports with `const { treatmentCategoryDb, clinicDb } = require('../db')`. Replace getDefaultClinic() with clinicDb.getDefaultClinic(). Replace TreatmentCategory.find(filter) with treatmentCategoryDb.findAll(filter). Remove the MongoDB-ism `$or: [{ clinicId: clinic._id }, { clinicId: { $exists: false } }]` — use clinic_id=$1 only. Replace create/findById/save/findByIdAndUpdate with treatmentCategoryDb.create/findById/update/toggleActive. Replace _id.toString() with .id in toShape().

Migrate Backend/src/services/patient.service.js: Replace all model imports with db imports from '../db'. Remove all inline require('mongoose') calls. Replace mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid() with isValidUUID() from '../utils/isValidUUID'. In getAllPatients(): replace Mongoose find/populate/sort/skip/limit with patientDb.findAll(filter) — pass search, status, doctorId, categoryId, sortBy, sortOrder, page, limit to patientDb. Remove the deletedPatients $nin workaround — patientDb.findAll() handles this in SQL via JOIN condition. In getPatientById(): replace with patientDb.findById(id). In createPatient(): remove Patient.countDocuments; remove treatmentCategoryName from create payload; replace Patient.create with patientDb.create(data) (patient_number auto-generated by sequence — remove from payload); for the inline appointment creation, call appointmentDb.create() directly (see IMPORTANT note below). In updatePatient(): remove treatmentCategoryName and patientNumber from allowed fields; replace with patientDb.update(id, body). In softDeletePatient(): replace with patientDb.softDelete(id) + appointmentDb.bulkSoftDeleteByPatient(patientId). Update toFrontendShape() to use .id instead of ._id.toString() and handle JOIN result structure (p.assigned_doctor_name, p.treatment_category_name, etc.).

IMPORTANT for patient.service.js createPatient(): The inline appointment block currently creates an appointment by calling Appointment.create() directly (not bookAppointment()). After migration, call appointmentDb.create() directly with the appointment fields. Strip out patientName, patientPhone, doctorName, date, time, treatmentCategoryName from the appointment create payload — these fields do not exist in the appointments table. Keep: clinic_id, patient_id, doctor_id, treatment_category_id, start_at, end_at, duration_minutes, status, priority, notes, created_by_id. The appointment_number is auto-generated by the sequence.

Migrate Backend/src/services/appointment.service.js: Replace all model imports with db imports. Remove all inline require('mongoose') calls. Replace mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid() with isValidUUID(). In getAllAppointments(): replace Mongoose filter/populate/sort with appointmentDb.findAll(query). Remove the deletedPatients $nin workaround — handled in SQL. In bookAppointment(): replace Patient.findById/User.findById/TreatmentCategory.findById with patientDb/userDb/treatmentCategoryDb.findById. Replace Appointment.findOne overlap detection with appointmentDb.checkOverlap(doctorId, startAt, endAt). Remove Appointment.countDocuments — sequence handles number. Replace Appointment.create with appointmentDb.create. Replace patient.save() for assignedDoctorId update with patientDb.update(patientId, {assigned_doctor_id: doctorId}). In updateAppointmentStatus(): replace Appointment.findById with appointmentDb.findById; replace status-specific saves with appointmentDb.updateStatus(id, fields); replace Patient.findById+save with patientDb.update; replace new appointment creation with appointmentDb.create; remove countDocuments. Update toFrontendShape() to use .id and handle JOIN result columns (a.patient_name instead of a.patientId.name, etc.).

Migrate Backend/src/services/payment.service.js: Replace model imports with db imports. Remove inline require('mongoose'). Replace mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid() with isValidUUID(). In addPayment(): remove Payment.countDocuments and Invoice.countDocuments; replace Invoice.create with invoiceDb.createWithItems(invoiceData, [{description, quantity, unit_price, discount, amount}]); replace Payment.create with paymentDb.create(data) — do NOT pass receipt_number. In getRevenueSummary(): replace Payment.aggregate with paymentDb.getRevenueSummary(clinic.id). In getAllPayments(): replace with paymentDb.findAll(filter). In getPaymentsByPatient(): replace with paymentDb.findByPatient(patientId). In softDeletePayment(): replace with paymentDb.softDelete(id). Update toFrontendShape() to use .id and handle JOIN result (p.patient_name from JOIN instead of p.patientId.name).

Migrate Backend/src/services/clinical.service.js: Replace model imports with db imports. In getClinicalRecordsByPatient(): replace ClinicalRecord.find with clinicalRecordDb.findByPatient(patientId). Remove JSON.parse(r.prescription) — the prescription field no longer exists; return `prescription: []` in the mapped result for backward compatibility. In addClinicalRecord(): remove JSON.stringify(prescription); remove doctorName from create payload; replace ClinicalRecord.create with clinicalRecordDb.create(data), passing dentalChart as a JS array directly; replace Patient.findById+save with patientDb.update(patientId, fields); replace Appointment.findById+save with appointmentDb.updateStatus(appointmentId, {status:'completed', completed_at:new Date()}).

Migrate Backend/src/services/ai.service.js: Replace AiReport/File/Patient/Clinic model imports with db imports (aiReportDb, fileDb, patientDb, clinicDb). In uploadAndAnalyzeXray(): replace Patient.findById with patientDb.findById; replace File.create with fileDb.create(data); replace AiReport.create with aiReportDb.create(data). In getAiReportsByPatient(): replace AiReportModel.find().populate() with aiReportDb.findByPatient(patientId). In reviewAiReport(): replace AiReport.findById+save with aiReportDb.update(reportId, fields). Keep UPLOAD_DIR and callMlService() unchanged — Supabase Storage migration happens in FEAT-004.

Migrate Backend/src/routes/index.js (dashboard + reminders): Remove top-level Appointment/Patient/Payment model requires. Add `const { statsDb } = require('../db'); const { appointmentDb, patientDb } = require('../db');`. In GET /api/stats/dashboard: replace all 5 countDocuments calls with statsDb.getDashboardCounts(todayStart, todayEnd); replace Payment.aggregate for today revenue with statsDb.getTodayRevenue(todayStart, todayEnd); replace Payment.aggregate for total revenue with statsDb.getTotalRevenue(); replace Appointment.aggregate for category breakdown with statsDb.getCategoryBreakdown(). Assemble categoryBreakdown by joining getCategoryBreakdown() result with allCategories from treatmentCategoryService. All values divide paise by 100 for display. In POST /api/notifications/send-reminders: replace Appointment.find with appointmentDb.findRemindersToSend(tomorrowStart, tomorrowEnd); replace Patient.findById with patientDb.findById(apt.patient_id); replace Appointment.findByIdAndUpdate with appointmentDb.updateStatus(apt.id, {reminder_sent:true, reminder_sent_at:new Date()}).

Migrate Backend/src/config/seed.js: Replace all Mongoose model imports with db imports. In seedDatabase(): (1) Clinic: replace Clinic.findOne/{}/create with clinicDb.getDefaultClinic() — if it creates, use flat address columns (address_line1:'Sector 12', address_line2:'', address_city:'Dwarka', address_state:'Delhi', address_postal_code:'110075', address_country:'India'). (2) Staff: replace User.findOne/create/save with userDb.findByEmail/createUser/updateUser; use clinic_id (not clinicId) and password_hash (not passwordHash) as field names. (3) Categories: replace TreatmentCategory.findOneAndUpdate with treatmentCategoryDb.upsertByCode(cat.code, clinic.id, {...cat, clinic_id: clinic.id}). (4) Patients: replace Patient.findOne/create with patientDb.findByPatientNumber/create; remove patientNumber from create payload (accept auto-generated); use snake_case field names (clinic_id, date_of_birth, blood_group, chief_complaint, assigned_doctor_id, registered_at, is_deleted). (5) Appointments: replace Appointment.countDocuments/create with appointmentDb.create; remove appointmentNumber from payload; use snake_case field names (clinic_id, patient_id, doctor_id, treatment_category_id, start_at, end_at, duration_minutes, is_deleted, created_by_id).
acceptance_criteria: No `require('mongoose')` or `require('../models/')` in any service file or routes/index.js or config/seed.js.
node index.js from Backend/ starts without error, connects to Supabase, and seeds 1 clinic + 6 users + 10 categories + 15 patients + up to 19 appointments.
POST /api/auth/login with admin@dwarkadental.com / admin123 returns 200 with { user, role, token }.
GET /api/patients with Bearer token returns { data: [...], pagination: {...} } shape.
POST /api/patients with valid body creates patient and returns { patient, appointment, payment }.
GET /api/appointments?view=today returns appointments with patient_name, doctor_name, treatment_category_name populated.
GET /api/stats/dashboard returns { totalPatients, todayAppointments, missedAppointments, upcomingAppointments, completedAppointments, todayRevenue, totalRevenue, categoryBreakdown }.
GET /api/clinical/:patientId returns array of records each with prescription: [].
toFrontendShape() functions in all services use .id (not ._id.toString()) and return identical field names as before migration.
verification: cd Backend && node index.js — server must start, connect to Supabase, seed without errors
curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"admin@dwarkadental.com","password":"admin123"}' — returns 200 with token
export TOKEN=<token from above> && curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' http://localhost:5000/api/patients — returns paginated patient list
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' http://localhost:5000/api/stats/dashboard — returns all 7 stat fields
